closest.explanation: Put in $129,000 more of your own cash (owner equity $320,000 -> $449,000) and borrow that much less. Only if you really have this cash: the lender checks equity against bank statements (NSP-3.1, SYNTHETIC program). Plan after the change: owner equity $449,000, loan $196,000 over 120 months, build-out $425,000, cash reserve at opening $220,000; equity injection 69.6% of the project (the SYNTHETIC program asks for at least 20.0%, NSP-3.1). Result (simulated, based on stated assumptions; 1,000 simulated futures, seed 2847489774): chance that year-2 DSCR is at least 1.25: 0.722 -> 0.780 (target: at least 0.80); chance that year-2 DSCR stays at least 1.00 under the lender's 20% revenue stress: 0.495 -> 0.549 (target: at least 0.80); chance that cash falls below zero within 24 months: 0.088 -> 0.061 (target: at most 0.10). Still missed: the year-2 DSCR target, the lender's revenue-stress target. The lender's own check on the year-2 median (NSP-4.1 and NSP-4.2): projected DSCR 3.17 -> 5.26, revenue-stressed DSCR 0.92 -> 1.53. Reaching these simulated targets does not mean a lender will approve the loan. Lenders make their own decisions.
closest.unchanged: Unchanged: your credit score, your experience, your other debts (none listed), the site's demand estimate, every assumption range and the note rate.

disclaimer: Educational planning tool. Not financial, legal or lending advice. Lenders make their own decisions.
guardrail_note: Reaching the targets is not an approval: Studio never approves, declines or recommends a lender.
guardrails: Only plan choices move: owner equity, loan amount, build-out cost, cash reserve at opening, price, days open, loan term and the choice between your own candidate sites in the same metro.
Facts never move: your credit score, your experience, your other debts (never hidden or reduced), the site's demand estimate, the note rate and every figure you marked as verified.
Assumption ranges never move: they describe the market and are changed with evidence, never to pass a target.
Every change-set is checked field by field; anything outside its levers' own fields that differs from your plan is refused.
Every amount stays inside your bounds whichever lever moves it, and sources always equal uses.
A change-set may not break a rule of the SYNTHETIC startup program that your plan meets now (equity injection NSP-3.1, loan amount and term limits NSP-8.1).
Reaching the targets is not an approval: Studio never approves, declines or recommends a lender.
label: simulated, based on stated assumptions

levers_considered.label: Owner cash equity
levers_considered.name: owner_equity
levers_considered.note: Only counts if the founder really has this cash; the lender verifies equity with bank statements (NSP-3.1, SYNTHETIC program). The default upper bound (+20% of project cost) is a placeholder for the founder's own answer.

levers_considered.label: Loan amount
levers_considered.name: loan_amount
levers_considered.note: Borrowing less lowers the payments and the cash at opening by the same dollars; borrowing more does the opposite.

levers_considered.label: Build-out and equipment cost
levers_considered.name: build_out_cost
levers_considered.note: Only valid if the same business can be built for less (a lower quote, used equipment). A smaller build-out that also cuts capacity is not modeled, so the default bound is a 15% saving.

levers_considered.label: Cash reserve at opening
levers_considered.name: working_capital_reserve
levers_considered.note: Extra reserve is funded by the founder's own cash, so owner equity must stay inside its bounds too (with the default bounds that means this lever only adds cash). The low bound of 0 matters for the loan lever, whose change the reserve absorbs.

levers_considered.label: Loan term
levers_considered.name: loan_term_months
levers_considered.note: The lender sets the term; the founder can ask for a longer one. The default bounds are the SYNTHETIC startup program's term limits (NSP-8.1).

levers_considered.label: Candidate site (same metro)
levers_considered.name: site
levers_considered.note: Only sites the founder listed as candidates in the same metro, each with its own demand estimate; the demand estimate of a site is never edited.

message: No path within your bounds: no change of one or two plan choices inside your bounds reaches all three targets (simulated, based on stated assumptions). The closest result is shown. Next steps are to widen a bound you can really widen, or to rethink the plan itself (site, size, concept).
notes: Metro synthetic_metro runs in synthetic mode: SYNTHETIC metro: generated data for demonstration and validation only.

Pairs are searched only for levers that do not reach the targets alone but move the plan closer on their own, and the pair grid assumes that moving a lever further in its helpful direction does not hurt; a pair can be missed when that does not hold.
Quick mode: searched with 500 simulated paths and a coarser grid; every number shown was re-checked with 1000 paths (0 change-set(s) dropped because they missed a target in the re-check).
Price and days open are not part of the plan form yet, so the search did not move them (they are locked).
